runtime_trace.interpretation: The first-race transition uses $2142 as a rolling echoed sequence/handshake byte and $2143 as the payload byte. Three $2142-only transitions split the payload into four transfer chunks.

evidence: 02:8298-02:82A4 is a self-contained initializer that clears DP $68/$6C/$6A and returns; the previous transfer label at $8298 was too broad.
02:82A5 is exactly JSR $82A9 / RTL and has 12 direct long-call sites.
02:82A9 initializes $6F, stores caller X at DP $83, reads LDA $030000,X, and flows into the proven $2142/$2143 transport loop.
02:82F0 executes LDA [$63],Y and 02:82F2 writes that byte to $2143.
02:82F5 XBA / 02:82F6 STA $2142 writes the sequence/handshake byte.
02:8301 CMP $2142 / BNE waits for the echoed handshake before advancing.
Y increments per payload byte; when Y wraps, 02:82FC INC $65 advances the 24-bit working source pointer rooted at direct-page $63.
02:831C LDA #$80, 02:831E STA $2142 and the echo loop at 02:8321 terminate the observed transfer phase.

helper.interpretation: Small helper that writes a byte to $2143, swaps accumulator bytes, writes the paired value to $2142, waits for echo, increments, swaps back, and returns.

spc_correlation.explanation: After removing 12 transfer-control/header bytes and accounting for a 3-byte overlap between the first two chunks, the runtime $2143 stream reconstructs APU RAM $B0E0-$BDE0 exactly. That entire 3,329-byte region is byte-identical at the same offsets in all five numbered-race SPCs and Unused Song 2.
related_shifted_matches: Celebration contains the same matched chunk contents at shifted APU locations.
Title Screen shares the 2,115-byte middle chunk at APU $8619.
Demo Race and Unused Song 1 share the final 411-byte chunk at APU $7BA8.

interpretation: The CPU-side transfer body is 02:82A9, not 02:8298; 02:8298 is a short transfer-state initializer.
The observed first-race transition copies a large race-family APU data block through $2143 while synchronizing each byte through $2142.
The first-race ROM-side source seed is directly measured as 03:FB55, one member of a compact family of caller-supplied bank-03 seeds.

The matched high-APU-RAM region is distinct from the previously identified shared BRR sample-bank prefix at $3000-$5F87, so it is more plausibly driver-side tables/sequence/state data than the common sample payload itself.
The ROM serialization and mapping from source seeds to songs/packages are not yet decoded, so unused-song reachability remains open.
next_discriminator: Decode helper 02:812A, which APU_StreamTransfer calls after every non-FF selector ID, to map IDs 0x00-0x31 to ROM blocks/APU destinations. Then associate the six 64-byte selector tables and their callers with song/package states; in particular test the uncalled 03:FB95 table against Unused Song 1/2 evidence.

rom_source.runtime_corroboration: At frame 906 the first paired WRAM writes to DP $83/$84 are $55/$FB, reconstructing X=$FB55; subsequent pairs advance $FB56, $FB57, and onward. Six static long-call sites load X=$FB55 immediately before JSL $82:82A5.
rom_source.interpretation: The retail transfer body has a directly observed bank-03 selector/cursor path. DP $63-$65 is a working pointer inside the transport; generic D+$00 upload-stream semantics must not be projected onto this routine without decoding the ROM serialization.

selector_table_format.interpretation: Each table is a 64-slot package/block selector list. The live first-race cursor visits exactly FB55-FB94 while $6F counts down from $40; FF slots are skipped quickly and populated IDs invoke block-transfer work.
selector_table_format.generic_parse_rejection: At FB55 the generic length16/target16 grammar yields length 0x1800,target 0x0627 followed by a second header whose declared payload runs far beyond the bounded source window; this conflicts with the directly observed 64-iteration selector loop.

selector_tables.interpretation: Dormant/unreferenced package selector-table candidate; not yet attributable to either unused song.
